description: Find Korean statutes that implement or reference a specific EU directive or regulation. Input the EU document ID in "type:year/number" format (e.g., "regulation:2016/679" for GDPR). Returns matching Korean statutes with implementation status.

eu_document_id.description: EU document ID in format "type:year/number" (e.g., "regulation:2016/679" for GDPR)

in_force_only.description: Return only statutes currently in force (default: false)

primary_only.description: Return only primary implementing statutes (default: false)

name: get_korean_implementations
